> WyattAu web-estate: TS + SolidJS + Astro + Starlight kits under Bun,
> with optional custom wasm. Registry of record: estate.yml.

## Kits

- [@est/errcode](packages/errcode/SPEC.md): TS mirror of the errcode crate: 10 codes, status/code/reason/typeUri maps, RFC 7807 ProblemDetail. (v0.1.0, support, mirrors errcode)
- [@est/envelope](packages/envelope/SPEC.md): TS mirror of json-envelope: ApiResponse wire shape, snake_case pagination keys, strict decode. (v0.1.0, support, mirrors json-envelope)
- [@est/search](packages/search/SPEC.md): Client-side text search. TS implementation now; optional wasm enhancement via crates/search-wasm behind the same interface. (v0.1.0, support)
- [@est/search-wasm](packages/search-wasm/SPEC.md): wasm-backed SearchIndex; artifact built by scripts/build-wasm.sh, version-locked to crates/search-wasm. (v0.1.0, support, mirrors search)

## Consumers

- directory: apps/directory

## Crates (wasm)

- search-wasm: crates/search-wasm

Read AGENTS.md for the repo contract.
